Resonite Crystals can be found in Boulderslide Cavern in Stonetalon Mountains. They have traces of Earthen magic.
Resourceful is an achievement earned by upgrading all star recipes in one primary profession to 2 stars or higher.

Resonating Arrow is the hunter class ability of the Kyrian Covenant. It's available to all hunters who join the Kyrian. This ability is also temporarily available during the Bastion portion of the Shadowlands campaign; it's given by the quest The Archon's Answer and lasts until you finish the Bastion storyline.
Were you looking for: * General information on Resistances to Schools of Magic? – OR – * The hunter's pet ability to increase their Resistances?

The Retaking of Andorhal is a battle that was named so by Maddox as he was overconfident in his chances he would retake the city. However, the Scourge was victorious and the entire army was destroyed.

Rethu Ironhorn was a legendary Highmountain tauren miner. Revered by miners and blacksmiths, Rethu was one of the first tauren settlers in the Broken Isles. His descendants carry on his traditions of metalworking at the Ironhorn Enclave, near the top of Highmountain Peak. His weapon was the :Spear of Rethu.

Both fragments are found in the southeastern corner of the basement of the Altar of the Blood God on the center island of Zul'Gurub, though the fragmented bijou requires being in the spirit world as part of the Jin'do the Godbreaker encounter. Reusable is a general term for an item that is not consumed when used. Reusable items do not have charges, and generally an item that has a Use: description in the tooltip but has no charges listed in the tooltip is reusable. Exceptions may exist; one that comes to mind is an item that completes a quest is essentially not reusable no matter how it is described. If they do have charges then they are not necessarily destroyed at 0 charges and can be refilled/recharged in some manner much like several pre-BC goblin engineering items. To mitigate the power of such an item, reusable items generally have a cooldown during which they cannot be used. Items with insignificant affect on gameplay may n
Revealing Strike is a Combat rogue ability, available at level 20. It applies a debuff which enhances the effectiveness of other rogue abilities against the target.

Revive Battle Pets is an ability that heals a player's Battle Pets to full health, and resurrects any pets that are dead. It is gained through learning Battle Pet Training. Unusually, the cooldown for this ability does not elapse when the character is logged out. To heal pets without waiting for the cooldown, a player can speak to a Stable Master and pay , or use a Battle Pet Bandage.

Returning Champion is a heirloom looted from the Darkmoon Treasure Chest during the Darkmoon Deathmatch. Once a player has obtained the Master Pit Fighter, they are then able to loot the heirloom. It is best to have auto loot off, as another player can still loot the Pit Fighter.

The Reverly Retreat is a large two-floor building located in the Evermoon Commons of Suramar City in Suramar. It houses Nightborne Wretches and is guarded by a Duskwatch Highblade and a Duskwatch Orbitist. A Treasure Chest can be found on the second floor. There's a Grapple Point on the building.
Richard Kerwin is a Forsaken warlock trainer located in the Magic Quarter in the Undercity.
Rhiannon Davis is a Forsaken located in the Magic Quarter in the Undercity.

Ricter was a Forsaken found in the Lordamere Internment Camp in the Alterac Mountains. Magus Wordeen Voidglare wanted the Bloodstone Marble that Ricter had. He, alongside Alina and Dermot, belonged to the group of undead led by Kegan Darkmar which turned away from Undercity, stole the Bloodstone Artifacts from a secure vault and went to the Lordamere Internment Camp.
Rides of War is a promotional Feats of Strength achievement rewarded for obtaining the Stormwind Skychaser and Orgrimmar Interceptor flying mounts for BlizzCon 2017.

Riders are combat units within an army. What sets them apart from a regular soldier is the ability to ride a mount into battle. Each race has different beasts for each rider, with some being able to fly.

The Ring of Spell Power used to be the most powerful spell damage ring in game but did not have any other stats. Rimblat Earthshatter is a tauren quest giver located in the Eastern Plaguelands. He is affiliated with the Earthen Ring. He believes that the Plaguelands is not beyond saving. Prior to the Cataclysm, he was found at Light's Hope Chapel aiding shaman adventurers with The Earthshatterer set.
__NOTOC__ Rilak the Redeemed is an arakkoa quest giver located in the Lower City in Shattrath City. He can be found just north of the lower-level exit of the Aldor bank.

The Ring of the Kirin Tor is sold by in Dalaran for . It can cost as low as at reputation with the Kirin Tor. It allows the user to teleport to Dalaran in Northrend every 30 minutes, and does not share a cooldown with the Hearthstone or most other teleport items.

Rimefang is a frost wyrm of the Frostbrood. Rimefang was originally the frost wyrm mount of Scourgelord Tyrannus the dreadful master of the Pit of Saron, who was killed by the champions of Jaina Proudmoore and Sylvanas Windrunner. After fleeing the scene, Rimefang waited as a guardian ready to kill the Ashen Verdict's heroes invading the Frostwing Halls. Frosty was accidentally created when the Lich King's deathly powers raised Rimefang from undeath. Rimefang's harness, left over after his defeat, had the power to bind frost wyrms to others' will. Vrykul raiders used it in the Pit of Saron for exactly that. After the Knights of the Ebon Blade retrieved the harness, they used it to raise Thor

Rilgiz is, along with Branzlit, Kixa and Perixa one of four bankers in the Bank of Orgrimmar which is located in the Valley of Strength of Orgrimmar. After the battle of the Broken Shore, he could be found outside the bank talking to Grunt Karus and watching the concerned citizens of the Horde in front of Grommash Hold. After the Battle at the Gates of Orgrimmar, he refused a Former Banshee Loyalist access to the Bank of Orgrimmar in the Valley of Strength, Baine Bloodhoof declared that many were led astray by Sylvanas's lies and thus they must come together as a united Horde. He further declared that those who seek forgiveness are forgiven and should be allowed to use Rilgiz's service, to w

Rimefang's Harness is a powerful magical harness of the frost wyrm Rimefang. The Sveldrek vrykul got hold of it and used it to subjugate new frost wyrms, until the Deathlord and Minerva Ravensorrow attacked the Sveldrek in the Pit of Saron and claimed it for the Knights of the Ebon Blade.

The Rimescale are a group of naga operating in Stormheim and Highmountain. They invaded Vrekt and were, in turn, targeted by Odyn. In Highmountain, they led an incursion into Rockaway Shallows where they captured murloc tadpoles. When they were defeated, they retreated from the area.

Rise of the Horde is a novel by Christie Golden focusing on the events of the Old Horde and its culture in the Warcraft universe. Chris Metzen himself commented on the book, which features the draenei's flight from Argus and, as the title implies, the corruption of the orcs. :"The book DOMINATES, and you're going to really dig it. Durotan, Ner'zhul, Gul'dan, Doomhammer, Hellscream, Kil'jaeden, Velen; this story is the one you've been waiting for. I'm getting geeked up just thinking about it." The book is written from the 3rd-person perspective, except for a note every chapter narrated by Thrall in the first person. Most of the story is told from the perspective of Durotan and Velen. Rit'ko is the torturer of the Shatterspear tribe and can be found in the Shatterspear War Camp in Darkshore. He is surrounded by dead and wounded Sentinels that he has sadistically tortured in unspecified ways. Among his victims was Alanndarian Nightsong, and he also had Sentinel Aynasha caged up. Players confront him as he finishes with one of his victims.

Rinn Firecaster was a blood elven apprentice jewelcrafter who specialized in dawnstones. He worked at Gallaran's in Silvermoon City. He had come to Tirisfal Glades to deliver a gem to the undead merchant Jillian Grell. Unfortunately he was killed by Captain Renee Lauer of the Scarlet Crusade when he had just arrived at Jillian's old farm. His death set a series of events in motion, resulting in the deaths of his sister and Jillian's uncle, and the raising of Renee Lauer as one of the undead.
Ringmaster is an achievement awarded for flying through 25 rings in one flight session of the Firebird's Challenge event. See the linked article for details and tactics.

__NOTOC__ The Risen Skulker is a skeletal guardian pet for Unholy death knights who have the All Will Serve talent. It's summoned along with the death knight's Risen Ally via Raise Dead (death knight ability). Temporary Risen Skulkers can also be summoned with the Bone Borrower and Bone Harvester anima powers.

Rival Nations is a custom map for Warcraft III in which there are three teams of three, pitted against each other in a free-for-all Aeon of Strife format. Each player begins the game with one hero of their choosing, and battles computer controlled armies until becoming powerful enough to destroy the opposing teams' Castle. The biggest difference between Rival Nations and other AoS styled maps is that in Rival Nations you are able to purchase and control more than one hero. This leads to increased strategy and micro requirements in order to be victorious. Started in the summer of 2002, it was developed by MicrosoftXP until June 2004. The River's Heart is located in the central part of the Sholazar Basin. It is a small lake, under the sea level and surrounded by cliffs, in which all the four rivers of the region meet at its center and drain down high waterfalls into the basin. On its northeastern shore, the lake’s got a nice little beach named the Lakeside Landing and some trees around it, which means it must have been deeper at some point. The lake itself is infested with Stranded Threshers that were washed in from the rivers that lead into it from the sea. Rituals of the New Moon is created with Inscription (350); taught by Technique: Rituals of the New Moon.

The Rivermane tribe is one of the four tribes of the Highmountain tauren, led by Jale Rivermane. They are a highly peaceful and diplomatic tribe, focused on fishing, agriculture and shamanism. In exchange for protection and equipment, they provide the other tribes with food and healing. The Rivermane were the ones to first establish the fragile peace pact between the Highmountain tauren and the drogbar as a means to survive in relative peace, and they have long been closer to the drogbar than the other tribes. The drogbar have long provided the Rivermane with potent alchemy to protect their crops from insects and in return, the Rivermane provided them with most of their food between their fi
Rivermane Boxers are Highmountain tauren boxers and members of the Rivermane tribe found training and competing under the supervision of Trainer Kod in a cave south of Skyhorn in Highmountain.
Rivermane Fishermen are Highmountain tauren located in Thunder Totem in Highmountain.
Rivermane Tauren are Highmountain tauren located in Highmountain.
Rivermane Prisoners are Highmountain tauren held in Legion Cages in Feltotem in Highmountain during Legion Assaults.

Four Ritual Pedestals can be found in a small set of ruins just southeast of the Harpy Roost on Exile's Reach. The ogres of the island have used them to imprison a Lightspawn who attempted to put a stop to the necromantic rituals on the island.

Ritual Remedy is created by combining Somnium Bark and Sleeping Glory at the Moon Water Ritual Bowl in the Haven Cascades in the Emerald Dream. It is used to help Shandris Feathermoon separate her from the dream spirit inside her.

Roaches, or cockroaches are small insects that can be found skittering about in the dankest corners of Azeroth. A nuisance to most, their incredible survivability sets them apart from other species, and most creatures cannot withstand a fraction of the harsh conditions that roaches can thrive in. However, not even cockroaches were strong enough to withstand the demonic corruption in Felwood. Some roaches have developed a resistance to fire. The outer member of the roaches' eggs protect the larva from incineration, and it is here in incubation that they gain the ability to resist the scorching temperatures of their volcanic environment. The cockroaches of Deepholm can burrow into stone itself

__NOTOC__ Roberto Pupellyverbos is a human wine vendor located in the Gallina Winery in the Canals section of Stormwind City, on the perimeter of the Trade District. He is apparently a connoisseur of merlot wine. He was present among the concerned citizens when the Veiled Hand and the Uncrowned infiltrated the city. He appears in the Vision of Stormwind in a maddened state, attacking the heroes. He is depicted as a and his shop is full of buckets of blood.

A location somewhere on Azeroth. The Last Guardian, Medivh, once lived in this desolate place. Heroes face the lingering magics, and silence the ghosts who haunt his former home. They beware the enclosed city as it is certain death for the unprepared.

Rizzle's Depth Charge is a depth charge placed in the river along side Azshara and Ashenvale to disrupt the druid from chasing its owner, Rizzle Sprysprocket. They only appear during the quest Chasing the Moonstone in which you must catch Rizzle, after she had stolen the moonstone from the druid.

The Road of Glory is the main sub-zone of Ashran, on , running the length of the island between Warspear in the north and Stormshield in the south. This long and dangerous road sees the Alliance and Horde battling for glory and supremacy, as well as control of the five capturable Towers spaced along its length. The Road is directly connected to almost all the other sub-zones of Ashran. The Road of Glory lacks the hostile mobs and special items and objectives of the secondary areas, instead hosting the island's main battle between the Alliance and the Horde.

Rock Flayer Island is a small island located at the Colossal Depths, just north of Frostfire Ridge, filled with rock flayers—Frost Flayers and Frost Flayer Hatchlings. It is explored by the commander's followers in the garrison mission Where The Rock Flayers Went.

Rober Ronn, also known by the alias of Sky Kanth'tal, leads a group of Theramore defectors. He made a deal with the Scalebane of Onyxia's brood, Madaggan: after usurping the Alliance (with the aid of the black dragonkin) and using its army to crush the Horde, they would take Durotar and Mulgore to live there and leave all of Dustwallow for the black dragonflight. In spite of his grand schemes, however, he wished for the name "Rober Ronn" to remain unblemished in Theramore and to that end he used illusory magic to disguise himself as a high elf named Sky Kanth'tal.
]] The Robodrome is an arena in the entrance Mechagon City, right after the Junkwatt Depot. During Operation: Mechagon, the adventurers fought through here their way into the lost city.
Rock Worm Broodlings are jormungar larvae summoned by Jorhuttam in Highmountain Summit in Highmountain.

The rogue is a lightly armored class that specializes in melee damage. Their role in the world is that of an elite assassin, sneaky pickpocket, waylaying bandit and more. Some aren't magic users but use magic items. Others utilize the Void to attain relative invisibility, with some being able to instantly become completely invisible even in broad daylight. Rogues often initiate combat with a surprise attack from the shadows, leading with vicious melee strikes. When in protracted battles, they utilize a successive combination of carefully chosen attacks to soften the enemy up for a killing blow. They must take special care when selecting targets so that their combo attacks are not wasted, and

__NOTOC__ Rockbiter is a mountain giant quest giver located in a small camp south of the Ruins of Ravenwind in Feralas. He was supposed to watch Shay Leafrunner. He has been missing since the Cataclysm, possibly having succumbed to the corruption stemming from Taerar and become one of the Corrupted Cliff Giants. His campfire still burns. In Patch 10.2.5 Rockbiter and Shay Leafrunner can be found at Bel'ameth, just west of the Terrace of the Moon.

A rogue trainer is an NPC that offers rogues the opportunity to train abilities and reset their talent points. A general rule-of-thumb for finding the local Rogue trainer is to search the city's taverns or shadier establishments. After all, they know Stealth for a reason.

Rod of Undead Mastery is a wand that allows the user to cast animate dead and other spells allowing the wielder to control or create more undead or to desecrate. This golden rod is topped with a skull carved from ivory. The first of its kind was given to Sylvanas Windrunner by the lich Kel'Thuzad to aid her in her duties when she was part of the Scourge. The Forsaken, whom she leads, have no innate necromantic abilities or powers. She treasures the item as a means of replenishing her waning ranks. This rod can be used as a light mace, but its main purpose is the ultimate control of undead.
The Rogue Black Drake can be seen while flying between the Burning Steppes and Elwynn Forest. It battles Expeditionary Priests and Expeditionary Mountaineers. This creature has no loot when killed.

The Roiling Gardens is an area found just north of the Marshlands in Un'Goro Crater. The area has been thrown off balance with an increasing number of Bloodpetals inhabiting the place. The trees are enveloped with more flowers and vines than usual. Large, sporous blossoms project themselves from the ground where they once did not. If something is not done soon, the balance of nature here will be destroyed. This is the only area Green Power Crystals can be found.

Rofilian Dane is a Forsaken quest giver found inside the Nethergarde Mines in the Blasted Lands. The leader of Dreadmaul Hold Okrilla has sent him to the mines in order to help secure it for the Horde. He directs his reinforcements (Horde adventurers) to destroy the ore shipments and to kill the Alliance inside the mine as it grant the Horde a financial victory. Despite needing to stay invisible, he can't but insult the Alliance after hearing the ore has been destroyed, calling them lunkheads. He then sends adventurers to talk to Tak'arili, who is deep within the mine. It is unknown what became of him when the Iron Horde took over the mines, but he may have been killed during the process or
Rocketeer: Gold is awarded for completing The Real Race at the Darkmoon Faire with the Rocketeer within 11 tolls. Players who earn this achievement will be awarded the Everlasting Darkmoon Firework.
Rockaway Shallows is the northeastern coastline in Highmountain. It holds the ruins of the ancient elven city of Lian'tril.
Rockaway Shelf is a continental shelf found just off the shores of Rockaway Shallows in Highmountain.
Rods of Magical Fervor are sold for by Arcanist Tero'shan and Vazun Starspeaker during Island Expeditions.
Ronald Burch is a Forsaken cooking vendor located in Trade Quarter in the Undercity. He was present during the Battle for Lordaeron and could be evacuated out of the Undercity.
__NOTOC__ Roldemar is a blood elf innkeeper located at the Sanctum of the Stars in Shadowmoon Valley.
Rolin Rivertreader is a Highmountain tauren located at Thunder Totem in Highmountain.

Rordan Waterwise is a Highmountain tauren quest giver and member of the Rivermane tribe initially found in a small rowboat at Whitewater Wash in Highmountain. Having been injured during the battle with the drogbar, he sends the player to find his son Moozy and bring him to his wife, Sella. Rordan, Sella and Moozy are later found in the Hammer's Cradle at Thunder Totem.
Roren Longshadow is the flight master for the Sylvan Falls in Highmountain.
Ronos Ironhorn is a Highmountain tauren mining trainer found at the Ironhorn Enclave in Highmountain. He is a descendant of the legendary miner Rethu Ironhorn.

The Royal Library (or the Stormwind Library) of Stormwind City is located inside Stormwind Keep. There is an extensive collection of scrolls, tomes, books, and texts on anything of historical, religious, cultural, or bureaucratic significance here, and adventurers from all races of the Alliance come here to peruse the lore. Milton Sheaf seems to be the head librarian. The Royal Library boasted the Royal Gallery before the chamber was destroyed after Deathwing's attack. Harrison Jones teaches archaeology in the library.

Royal Shadowsong Amethyst is a socketed gem crafted by Jewelcrafting. Rotlimb Cannibals are a part of the Scourge infestation that is traversing the Dead Scar in Eversong Woods. These Ghouls often make raids on Fairbreeze Village or against the breaking walls into Silvermoon City.
Roxi Ramrocket is a goblin flying trainer found at the base camp on K3 on the southern tip of the Storm Peaks. She is found working on a Weathered Flying Machine.

The Royal Exchange Bank is a bank found in the Royal Exchange of Silvermoon City.
The Royal Exchange Auction House is an auction house found in the Royal Exchange of Silvermoon City.
The Rotting Mire is an Island Expedition in Battle for Azeroth. It is a swampy island chain inhabited by saurok, jinyu, and occasionally stranded pirates. Naga and tol'vir sometimes invade it too.
Royston Needs Help! is a bonus objective on Island Expeditions. Its objective differs depending on the island.

The Ruins of Thaurissan are what remains of the Dark Iron clan's original capital city. Little is known of the great city, but Royal Historian Archesonus of Ironforge has led research into its ruins found in the Burning Steppes, to reveal some information about the place. It was referred to as the home of the Dark Iron nation and later kingdom.

The Ruins of Kel'Theril are the remnants of a great night elven city. It was destroyed long ago during the Great Sundering, and now lies in complete ruin, haunted by the tormented spirits of the Highborne who did not survive the disaster. The ruins lie on the edges of Lake Kel'Theril in central Winterspring. There was a Remorseful Highborne here that gave a quest to Alliance players. New undead mobs are here now. In addition to the night elven spirits that still inhabit the northern section of ruins, high elven ghosts now inhabit the eastern section (Betrayed Rangers and Archmage Maenius) while blood elven wretched inhabit the western section (Wretched Spectres). The Emerald Circle druid Kel

The Ruins of Constellas is an area of Felwood. Xavathras, and his group of Jadefire satyr, inhabit the area. Judging by the remnants of the architecture, and the existence of a moonwell, it used to be one of the many night elven settlements near Mount Hyjal. The moonwell has since become corrupted with Fel energy, and is being cultivated by Xavathras on behalf of Xavaric. Druidic Emerald Bearkin are attacking the demons of the Ruins. A camp rests to the southeast where Eridan Bluewind and Arcanist Delaris await with quests. Further into the heart of the Ruins the path leading to Xavathras is blocked by a wall of fire.
The Ruins of Solarsal are some night elven ruins southwest of the destroyed Feathermoon Stronghold in Sardor Isle. Hatecrest naga inhabit the grounds.
The Ruins of Isildien are the ruins of a large night elven city in southwestern Feralas. The Gordunni ogres have made the ruins their home. It was destroyed 10,000 years ago.

The Ruins of Stardust are located in southwestern Ashenvale, south of Astranaar and west of the Talondeep Path. The ruins are situated on a lake island, and several large bog beasts roam the ruins, corrupted by the lake's tainted waters. Much like Iris Lake, the ruins have been exposed to the demonic rot from Felwood, and the area is tinted a sickly yellowish green color. The most notable exception is the stardust shrubs scattered about the area. They are unmarred by the taint, and are known to contain powerful healing properties if imbibed. The ruins were originally considered a holy place.

The Ruby Dragonshrine is the final resting place for the red dragons. It is an island of greenery and life in the snow-blasted wastes, befitting the red dragonflight, whose domain is the fire that gives both life and death. Nozdormu told the adventurers that it was formed when a single drop of Alexstrasza's blood striking the snows, melting through, and growing into the Crimson Oak that stands in its center. Located on the western edge of The Dragon Wastes, south of the Obsidian Dragonshrine, north of the Azure Dragonshrine, west-northwest of Wyrmrest Temple, just to the northeast of Snowfall Glade, and southeast of Agmar's Hammer. The Area is guarded by Ruby Watchers. At the time of the war
The Ruins of Tethys lie upon a small set of islands in the Grizzly Hills to the southwest of Bloodmoon Isle.

Ruckus is a goblin real estate speculator and quest giver located in the Shattered Strand of Azshara. She has decided to stake her claim to some prime beachfront property and enlists players to help her do so. Ruckus does not discriminate in handing out her quest and will offer it to anyone of a high enough level. However, it is intended to be part of the chain that sends players to the Shattered Strand in There Are Many Like It, and the quests meant to be done concurrently with hers - from and - are not available until players have completed the prior steps in the Azshara storyline.

Ruby Lake is a lake high above the Blazing Way and the Ordon Sanctuary in the northeastern corner of Timeless Isle. The only means of accessing the area is by aggroing a Highwind Albatross, letting it fly around the isle until reaching the area, then attacking again and killing it to drop down into the lake. The waters of Ruby Lake are colored a strange reddish hue, possibly due to the ruby crystals found deep within the mountains of the Timeless Isle.
Ruben Holen is a goblin found in a corner of the Chamber of Wisdom in the Shrine of Two Moons reading from a scroll while riding on a Disc of the Red Flying Cloud.

The Ruins of Elune'eth are a part of Meredil that is directly over Shal'Aran, possibly the same submerged building. Teleporting here is a faster way to the main road to Suramar City. It serves as the entrance to Tel'anor.
Ruby Flightstone is sold by Evantkis at the Valdrakken Treasury Hoard of Valdrakken in exchange for 1 Aspects' Token of Merit from the Great Vault. It contains 75x Flightstones.
Rudimentary Magical Lockpick was never made available. It would be used to open Magic-Bound Chests in the Dragon Isles.
Rune of Portals was a reagent used by mages to create a portal (spell) to major cities. Compare to Rune of Teleportation, which was used for the teleport spell.

The Rune of the Dawn is a trinket that serves as an and increases magical damage against undead enemies. As of the Cataclysm, the quests for earning it are no longer available, so new players cannot acquire it. However, players who completed the quests prior to the Cataclysm can still get a replacement if it has been destroyed. They can also acquire Seal of the Dawn instead. As stated, wearing it will cause undead mobs in the Plaguelands (and their dungeons) to drop scourgestones; however, these items no longer serve any purpose.
Runes of Teleportation were reagents used by mages to teleport to major cities.

Rumholt Thunderaxe, an Ironforge dwarf belonging to the Explorers' Guild, studied the Dark Irons for many months after learning of their reemergence. The Dark Irons had diverged from their Ironforge heritage in the few hundred years since the War of Three Hammers, gaining new abilities and losing old ones. Even their physical structure was different. Investigations into Rumholt's own family tree revealed that two of his ancestors — his grandfather's cousins — joined the Dark Irons during the war. This Iron dwarf is a rune smith at the mainbase Dun Argol. He holds a power cell needed for We Have the Power.

Rumbling Elementals were earth elementals appearing during the Elemental Unrest. Destroying the Elemental Rift creating these will apply the Earth Powered buff which procs as Earthen Restoration, healing you for 2% of your maximum health.

__NOTOC__ Rulen Lightsreap is a high elf paladin trainer located in the Silver Enclave in the mage city of Dalaran. He was present in the city when it relocated above Deadwind Pass but did not offer his training services as he had to remain alert for any danger to Dalaran's visitors.
Rune of Power is a row 4 mage talent. It acts as a ground-targeted spell power buff. It is an exclusive choice node with Incanter's Flow.

Rune Matching is a minigame that can be played on the Darkmoon Arcade Console at the Darkmoon Faire. When the game is launched, an array of colorful, glowing runes will appear in front of the player. Clicking two adjacent runes will attempt to swap their positions. The goal is to gain points by lining up three or more matching runes, causing them to drop out of the playing field. The player's score is displayed in yellow at the bottom of the field. Below that is a small, glowing cube that allows the game to be reset, randomizing the playing field and putting the score back to zero. This game will not automatically close once you win; to leave, right-click the Rune Matching buff.
Rummage Your Bag is an active racial ability for vulpera, which allows the player to change the active ability of their Bag of Tricks (racial).

Rune of Teleportation: Antechamber can be purchased from Archmage Tarsis Kir-Moldir in Naxxramas for during the Season of Mastery. You must first turn in Book of Deathstones: Rune of Teleportation I to purchase this item.

Rune of Teleportation: Frostwyrm's Lair can be purchased from Archmage Tarsis Kir-Moldir in Naxxramas for during the Season of Mastery. You must first turn in Book of Deathstones: Rune of Teleportation II to purchase this item.
in Eversong Woods.]] Runestones are large blocks of rock carved with powerful magical runes. The high elves of Quel'Thalas built several runestones along their borders.

The Rustbolt Resistor is an aerial unit flying mount purchasable from the Stolen Royal Vendorbot at Rustbolt on Mechagon Island, once you are with the Rustbolt Resistance. It costs ( after rep discount).

__NOTOC__ Rynthariel the Keymaster is a dryad in the Stonetalon Mountains. Kadrak wanted Rynthariel killed. Rynthariel was the Keymaster of the Talon Den on Stonetalon Peak. Together with the druids, she built the Talon Den, where they kept many powerful items. Hidden in a small lantern at the entrance of the Den, she hid the Gatekeeper's Key, with which she was able to open caches around the Den. She once guarded the entrance of the Den with Gatekeeper Kordurus.

Rutsak's Guard is a Forsaken outpost watching over Gilneas City in the Ruins of Gilneas. It is based out of an abandoned manor house, northeast of the city and east of Dreadwatch Outpost. After communication was lost with this post, it was discovered all the occupants had been slain, except for their leader Captain Rutsak, whom was left alive on purpose. Heroes are sent here during Break in Communications: Rutsak's Guard to investigate the situation. Captain Rutsak is found cowering inside where he informs the heroes that the 7th Legion is involved.

__NOTOC__ Lord Ruven Duskmere is a felborne that can be found at The Gilded Market in the city of Suramar. As a child, he was brash and full of pride, and his mother predicted that he would take great power for his own one day.

Rusza'thar Reach is the Dragonriding camp in northeastern Ohn'ahran Plains. Up on a high plateau, the reach overlooks Mudfen Village and Mirewood Fen to the north, the Cascades of Thaldraszus to the east, the Shikaar Highlands across the chasm to the south, Mountainview Post to the southwest, and the Horn of Drusahl to the west. Gensera runs the Rostrum of Transformation, and Malakesh runs flights, with connections to Pinewood Post, Maruukai, and Timberstep Outpost in the plains, and Valdrakken and the Garden Shrine of Thaldraszus. Ryth the Melodious is a human located at Stormwind City Cemetery in Stormwind City.
Saber's Eye of Strength is created with Legion Jewelcrafting (80); taught by Design: Saber's Eye of Strength.

SP may refer to: * A Shadow Priest. * Slave Pens, the instance in Coilfang Reservoir. * Stormpike, the faction. * Storm Peaks, a zone in Northrend. * Sunwell Plateau, an instance on the Isle of Quel'Danas * Spell Power, the Mage talent, or Spell power, the attribute that increases the effect of spells.

__NOTOC__ Sal'salabim is a quest giver located in the World's End Tavern in the neutral Shattrath City. He is a rebel mo'arg engineer who has taken up residence in the Sha'tari capital, drinking away his sorrows. He is loosely allied with Altruis the Sufferer, and helps the player assist Altruis in destroying Nagrand's forge camps, in return for the player collecting some debts he is owed. He apparently drank himself into a six hour blackout at least once, during which time someone may have stolen his tunic.

Salandria is a young Blood Knight trainee and apprentice of Lady Liadrin. Having grown up as an orphan in Shattrath City, she moved to Silvermoon to train as a paladin after Lady Liadrin discovered her strong potential with the Light. The young Salandria appears as the Blood Elf Orphan during Children's Week and can be summoned by Horde characters using the Blood Elf Orphan Whistle. She reappears, now as a grown young woman, in the Knights of Blood questline added in patch 9.2.5. Her Alliance counterpart during Children's Week is Dornaa.
Sacred Cleansing is a passive specialization ability for Holy paladins, available at level 34. It enables a paladin's Cleanse to dispel magic effects in addition to its normal mechanics.

The San'layn (sometimes spelled in lowercase) are a sect of vampiric darkfallen elves in service to the Scourge. They are known for their guile and dark magic, particularly the manipulation of blood and shadow magic. They used to be among Kael'thas Sunstrider's greatest followers, until they were raised into undeath by Arthas following Illidan Stormrage's failed assault on the Frozen Throne. During Battle for Azeroth, a number of San'layn led by Blood Prince Dreven were given a chance to join the Horde by Warchief Sylvanas if they could work with them, but Dreven was killed during his mission.
Samantha Shackleton is a Forsaken located in the Magic Quarter in the Undercity. She seems to be a researcher or librarian.
Salty McTavish is the flight master aboard the Voldrin's Hold in the contested territory of Shimmering Expanse. He works as a connection with the underwater flight masters of Vashj'ir.

Salvageable Greymist Wreckage are the remains of murloc hovels that were destroyed by the Shattering. Pieces of wreckage can be found along the shore and in the waters near Remtravel's Excavation. Archaeologist Groff asks Alliance players to collect some of the wreckage in order to build the Greymist murlocs a new home.
Sana Prepfoot is a Highmountain tauren and member of the Prepfoot standing next to the storehouse at the Prepfoot Compound in Highmountain.

The Sanctum of the Moon is an arcane sanctum located just to the west of Tranquillien. It has been overrun with arcane elementals and mana wyrms and has been partially destroyed. According to Alleria Windrunner, this was once a testament of the mastery of the arcane. Magister Umbric left his notes about Void experiments here, which were later found by Alleria.
Sanctum Defenders are blood elves found defending Sanctum of the Stars in Shadowmoon Valley when players initiate the quest The Deadliest Trap Ever Laid.

__NOTOC__ Sanctum Guardian Xerestrasza is a red dragonflight dragon (in high elf form) that can be found in the Ruby Sanctum. Baltharus the Warborn, one of the three mini-bosses, is attempting to get through the barrier she has created and is hiding inside of. She is one of the very few survivors after the attack by the black dragonflight. Xerestrasza appears at the Ruby Dragonshrine during The Deaths of Chromie scenario, she is leading the defense against a big Scourge army and needs the adventurer and Chromie's aid to push them back. While small pockets of undead come through from time to time in no hassle, Xerestrasza notes that the larger force is unusual and their true commander has hid
The Sandscalp clan is a clan of sand trolls who live on the Molten Cay and assault other islands looking for :Azerite. They are referred to as island trolls.

Sangrias Stillblade is a Blood Knight sent by Knight-Lord Bloodvalor to test new members of the order in mortal combat. He is summoned by lighting a brazier in a small cave on the Isle of Tribulations in Ghostlands, and then tries to kill his initiate opponent as a test. If Stillblade succeeds, then the initiate wasn't meant to be part of the brotherhood; if he fails, then his body is gathered by other initiates and placed on the second floor of the Silvermoon City Inn, where he remains dead until his victor can resurrect him. Following the death of Tirion Fordring, Sangrias joined the Silver Hand and is located in the Sanctum of Light, where with Lord Irulon Trueblade he grants paladins the
__NOTOC__ Sarithra is a blood elf warrior trainer located at the Farstriders' Square in Silvermoon City. She was present in the Court of the Sun during the closing of the remembrance ceremony.

Sandstone Hatchlings are aqir located at the Obelisk of the Moon in Uldum during the Assault in Uldum. They hatch in fives when Undisturbed Eggs are destroyed. They are quite fragile and will die on their own whether attacked or not after a short while.

Sariosa is a dryad flight master located in the Shady Sanctuary in the Ohn'ahran Plains. As part of preparing the defense of the Ancient Bough, Merithra tells Sariosa to help rally the green dragonflight's forces in the Emerald Gardens by sending out messages on the Messenger Mallards. __NOTOC__
Satyr hellcallers were the most powerful of the generic satyr creeps. They use warlock abilities and are satyr warlocks.

A Satyr Portal is only able to be built on the Warcraft III map 'Monolith' by a Satyr Gimp that has drawn power from the Mysterious Monolith. A Satyr portal takes shape of the aura 'Unholy Aura' and provides 20 food to the player. It also has 1200 hit points, making it difficult to destroy quickly, but cheap to construct (needing only 180 gold). The Structure summons seven types of Satyr from Warcraft 3: Satyr Gimps, Satyrs, Satyr Tricksters, Satyr Shadowdancers, Satyr Soulstealers, Satyr Hellcallers and Satyr Incinerators.

__NOTOC__ Sarvonis was one of the Highborne magi dispatched by Malfurion Stormrage to Ashenvale in an effort to aid Commander Delaryn Summermoon in defending the night elves' lands against the massive Horde invasion led by Sylvanas Windrunner in the War of the Thorns. Despite helping to burn the first bridge connecting the Falfarren River under Delaryn's orders in an attempt to slow the invasion, he and the other Highborne are all targeted and killed by the Forsaken dark rangers and possibly their Warchief herself later on in the conflict. Following his death, his body was encountered by the Horde in their quest to resurrect Delaryn Summermoon as a Forsaken.

.]] icon.]] The most primal of druids, savagekin bear an ancient but obscure legacy. Whereas some druids seek to command nature or bond with it, the savagekin surrenders himself to the natural world, abandoning much of his humanity to live with the beasts. Those who adopt this role may find they pay a steep price for power. Savagekin are druids who spend most of their time in animal form. They travel in packs with their fellow beasts. As animals they gain strength and finesse, but come close to becoming irreversibly feral. Savagekin constantly battle the inner beasts that threaten to consume them, clinging to their last vestiges of sentience. Half-elves, who straddle the world between human

Savage Vigor was a pet ability available exclusively to the rylak family of hunter pets, increasing player haste by 5% and Stamina by 10%. Due to its tandem benefits, Savage Vigor waes functionally superior to the goat family's Sturdiness and the bear family's Invigorating Roar, which only offered Stamina, and to the hyena, sporebat, and wasp families' Cackling Howl, Energizing Spores, and Speed of the Swarm, respectively, which only offered haste. A worthwhile alternative was the Qiraji Fortitude of the silithid family, which provides a boost to spell power instead of haste.
Scalesworn Elites are blue drakes who fly in circles around the top ring of the Nexus on the island of Coldarra in the Borean Tundra.

Scar of the Worldbreaker is a massive scar in the earth in the western Badlands, possibly caused by Deathwing's passage through the region. It stretches from just south of Angor Fortress to the southwest corner of the zone. Camp Wurg, Valley of Fangs and large portions of the Dustbowl and Mirage Flats are now a charred swath of destruction, with the nearby mountaintops sheared off. The tops of these mountains simmer like molten glass.

Scalehides are a type of tamable creature introduced with Legion. Scalehides are Ferocity pets, and their family-specific abilities are Smack and Scale Shield. The scalehide family include the following beasts: * Ankylodon * Kodo * Mushan * Stegodon * Thunder lizard * Shardhide

Scalecommander Sarkareth is one of the five Scalecommanders of the dracthyr. He originally led the Ebon Scales, but now leads the Sundered Flame which is composed of lesser dragonkin who are rebelling against the five dragonflights. He serves as one of the main antagonists of the second story arc of Dragonflight, alongside Fyrakk, and is the final boss of Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible.

The Scarlet Watchtower is a ruined scout tower located in southern Tirisfal Glades near the entrance to the Sewers of the Undercity. It is under the control of the Scarlet Crusade, who use it to keep a watchful eye on flight routes coming to and from the Forsaken capital. It is one of four Crusader's Outpost towers in the Tirisfal Glades. This particular tower is commanded by Captain Perrine.
Schematic: Honorable Combatant's Stormsteel Destroyer teaches blacksmiths to make Honorable Combatant's Stormsteel Destroyer. Ranks 2 and 3 reduces the materials required.
Schematic: Finely-Tuned Stormsteel Destroyer teaches engineers to make Finely-Tuned Stormsteel Destroyer. Rank 3 reduces the materials required.

__NOTOC__ Scooty is a goblin quest giver originally located in Booty Bay. He maintained the teleporter, and claimed to be a "master engineer". He was missing at the beginning of Cataclysm but it has since been revealed that he was taking the time and energy to move himself and his Gnomeregan teleporter up to Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

__NOTOC__ Scholar Runethorn is a night elf quest giver located at Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas, formerly an associate of the tauren Sage Korolusk, who likewise sought the whereabouts of Telmius Dreamseeker in Dire Maul. She has been missing since the Cataclysm, possibly having been killed in the naga attack on old Feathermoon Stronghold.
Scimitar of Atun drops from Murloc Scouts in the Redridge Mountains. It drops from Squiddic in the Redridge Mountains.

Scout Harefoot is a Highmountain tauren vignette found on the summit of the Heymanhoof Slope in Highmountain. Responsible for watching over the valley below and warning the village of Skyhorn of impending attacks, Harefoot was injured during a Vilewing harpy attack which also caused the death of his wife. Players can speak to him to help defend him and his infant son from two more waves, consisting of three Vilewing Ambushers each, before facing off against the harpy leader, Mynta Talonscreech, who drops the Harefoot Pinnacle Wrap.
Scout Brownmane is a Highmountain tauren located at Rockaway Coast in Highmountain. He is sitting on a bench with Scout Cloudeye.
Scout Cloudeye is a Highmountain tauren located at Rockaway Coast in Highmountain. She is sitting on a bench with Scout Brownmane.
Scout Proudhill is a Highmountain tauren located at Rockaway Coast in Highmountain. He often bickers with Scout Brownmane to the chagrin of Scout Cloudeye.

Scouring Tithe is the warlock class ability of the Kyrian Covenant. It's available to all warlocks who join the Kyrian. This ability is also temporarily available during the Bastion portion of the Shadowlands campaign; it's given by the quest The Archon's Answer and lasts until you finish the Bastion storyline.

In World of Warcraft, scouting can mean a couple of things: #A character with reconnaissance abilities like stealth or some form of sensory projection power to explore an area before the whole group enters, so they will be prepared for any encounters. #*Not as widely used a term as Tank, Healer, or Nuker. #*Scout

The Scribe of Stormwind is an inscription shop located in the Mage Quarter section of the Canals of the human capital of Stormwind City. The establishment provides both training and supplies to those who wish to learn and practice the art of inscription for a price. The entrance to the shop is located just south of the Stormwind Stockade, and beside the library of the Academy of Arcane Arts and Sciences. It is the chief center for inscription in the city.
The Scribe's Office produces all manners of magical inks, pigments, and paper, and can also create Glyphs and other magical items.
Scrolls of Flight are flight masters located in tortollan settlements throughout Kul Tiras and Zandalar.
Screechflight Staves drop from Screechflight Cursewifes in the Bluefeather Cliffs in Thaldraszus.

The Sea of Cinders is a relatively flat stretch of land in the southern area of the Searing Gorge, just north of Blackrock Mountain. The flat lands have been ravaged by fire and wind and are now an uninhabitable wasteland. Cinders and ashes from the still smoldering ground are constantly flying through the air, making it an extremely unpleasant area to travel through.

Scryer's Tier is a terrace in Shattrath City, and the base of operations for the Scryers. At the center of the Tier is the Seer's Library, which serves as the faction's headquarters. Scryer's Tier also boasts an inn run by Innkeeper Haelthol and a variety of vendors, including reputation vendors and a reagent vendor behind the Seer's Library. One who is favored by the Aldor will be attacked by Scryer guards and sent to the gates of Shattrath City with a three minute debuff if they attempt to visit the Scryer's Tier.
